{{Quote|Excuse me, I beg your pardon. Maybe you know my brother's boy; he's a member of the Imperial Military. He must be twenty-four, twenty-five years old by now; he loves the service, great little guy.|Saun Dann, breaking up a potential fight between an Imperial technician and Mallatobuck|<ref name="The Star Wars Holiday Special">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref>}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Saun Dann]] once claimed to have a '''brother''' while trying to prevent an [[Unidentified Imperial technician|Imperial technician]] from fighting with the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]]. According to him, the brother also had a [[Saun Dann's nephew|son]] in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'' is not clear as to whether Saun Dann is telling the truth about having a brother and a nephew, or simply making it up in an effort to distract the [[Technician/Legends|technician]]. Worth noting is that he tells several other tall tales to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] while trying to distract them.
